'''2021 Worlds Throwback Top 8 Matt Manning LS Rebel Strike Team''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matt Manning]] at the [[2021 Worlds Throwback Event]] (Top 8).

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Matt Manning]]
* '''Event:''' [[2021 Worlds Throwback Event]]
* '''Stage:''' Top 8
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Rebel Strike Team / Garrison Destroyed|Endor-L-rebelstriketeam.gif}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' [[Heading For The Medical Frigate]]
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:21WRPR2 Manning LS RST.txt |Download]]
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2021-worlds-retro-prem-ref-ii-event/ PC list] Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013162117/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2021-worlds-retro-prem-ref-ii-event.html Internet Archive]
